behaviors.open-email-normalizer: Email normalizer appears in the Development tools and opens when selected.
behaviors.normalize-email-lines: Entering email addresses on separate lines shows a normalized result for each line.
behaviors.show-parse-errors: An email address that cannot be parsed shows an “Unable to parse email” result for that line.
behaviors.copy-normalized-emails: Copy normalized emails copies the displayed results and shows a confirmation toast.
behaviors.clear-emails: Clear emails removes the entered addresses and their results.
behaviors.disable-copy-when-empty: The Copy normalized emails button is disabled when there are no results.

history.notes: The tour opens the tool through its visible link and uses the distinct textarea placeholders from the supplied component. The copy check reads the clipboard after granting browser clipboard permissions; the button’s disabled state is checked through its rendered class, as implemented by c-button.
